scene wintersky
Ahh, snow.
lines.zh: 啊，雪。

lines.en: Frozen water droplets guaranteed to fill the hearts of children with glee as they look outside of the window and realize there’s even a slight possibility of skipping school for a day.
lines.zh: 这些冻住的水珠，保证能让孩子们一看到窗外、意识到今天似乎有那么一点点可能不用去上学，心里就乐开了花。

lines.en: I try to recall a time in my life where those kinds of thoughts would find their way into my head.
lines.zh: 我试着回想自己人生中还有过这种想法的时期。

lines.en: Now, any time I look up and see something like this, I just think of it as an inconvenience.
lines.zh: 如今，每当我抬头看见这样的东西，只会觉得它是个麻烦。

lines.en: And so I take a moment to reflect on how things may have changed for me over the years.
lines.zh: 于是我花了一点时间，反思这些年自己身上发生了怎样的变化。

lines.en: : This is the holy grail, Yumi! I don’t know how much I can pay you, but if you’re willing to negotiate, I can have you start as early as next Monday night.

lines.en: : Also, can you agree to keep things confidential on the off chance that you find a family member or other loved one in a video?

lines.en: : Because sometimes, whether we like it or not, people are forced to do things they’re not very proud of for money- and as a retailer in this industry, you need to be willing to be confidential about-
